name: Nova Aerie
tagline: Engineer your ascent from the ladder's basement to its stratosphere.
positioning: Nova Aerie turns raw ranked grind into a deliberate climb — pairing individual players with elite coaches and telemetry-grade VOD analysis.

hero.h1: Stop grinding blind. Start climbing on purpose.
hero.sub: Nova Aerie fuses championship-caliber coaches with frame-by-frame VOD telemetry, so every ranked game moves you measurably closer to the peak you were meant to hold.

features.title: Telemetry VOD review
features.description: Upload a replay and get a timestamped breakdown of every misplay, cooldown wasted, and rotation missed — annotated by a coach who's held the rank you're chasing.

features.title: Personalized drill labs
features.description: Your weaknesses become a curriculum. Aim routines, macro scrims, and decision drills are generated weekly and adapt as your stats move.

features.title: Coach matchmaking
features.description: We pair you by role, region, and playstyle with a vetted coach — no random Discord DMs, no ghosting, no coaches learning your game on your dime.

features.title: Rank trajectory tracking
features.description: A single dashboard charts MMR, win-rate deltas, and habit streaks so you can see the climb curve instead of guessing whether the grind is working.

features.title: Live scrim overlays
features.description: Get real-time callouts and cooldown reminders piped into your practice sessions, then export the session as a shareable coaching artifact.

features.title: Tournament prep sprints
features.description: Two-week structured programs that peak your form for qualifiers — vod homework, mental resets, and a match-day checklist your coach signs off on.

testimonials.quote: I sat hardstuck in Diamond for three splits. Six weeks of Nova Aerie's VOD labs and my coach's rotation drills put me in Master with a plan I could actually repeat. It stopped feeling like luck.
testimonials.name: Mateo Reyes

testimonials.quote: The telemetry review is unreal — it caught a recurring off-angle habit I'd never have spotted myself. My aim consistency graph finally stopped looking like a heart monitor.
testimonials.name: Priya Anand

testimonials.quote: We route our whole amateur roster through Nova Aerie between bootcamps. The tournament prep sprints are the closest thing to a real org's structure that a small team can afford.
testimonials.name: Dane Kovic

pricing.blurb: For the solo grinder ready to climb with intent instead of hope.
For serious climbers chasing a specific rank on a real timeline.
For amateurs going pro who need an org-grade support system.

homepage.footerBlurb: Nova Aerie is the ascent engine for players who refuse to stay hardstuck. Elite coaching, telemetry, and structure — built for one climber at a time.
